isolation: cleared environment, networkless bwrap, read-only source and lock-identical venv, tmpfs project
interpretation: From 10k to 50k, the terminal fact grew 5.10x and sampled action RSS delta grew 3.67x, while action time grew 33.64x. The pair-heavy fingerprint fixture therefore exposes a superlinear compute concern in addition to linearly growing duplicate terminal metadata. The 6.87 MB fact occupies each of two durable owners while normalized result values contain 750000 logical bytes.
timing_scope: Fixture and action elapsed times use a tmpfs project. They are end-to-end diagnostic timings for relative scaling in this fixture and are not filesystem or disk-throughput measurements.
rss_caveat: VmRSS was sampled every 5 ms during the action. ru_maxrss covers the whole process and may differ from sampled VmRSS. Use sampled action delta for within-run action memory, regard peaks as approximate, and compare only fresh processes.
